archetypes.name: grant-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the relocation and grant-width plan really preserves the intended Codex write boundary under documented preconditions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the planned snapshot relocation is actually outside all relevant Codex writable grants for Step 5 and whether the retained Step 2 SESSION_TMPDIR grant is correctly scoped and justified. Look for mismatches between the plan's TMPDIR preconditions, launcher argv evidence, and SECURITY.md trust-boundary claims. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on cleanup, permissions, and lifecycle side effects introduced by relocating and chmodding round artifacts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for lifecycle gaps around read-only snapshot files, relocated TMPDIR directories, cleanup-tmpdir behavior, and post-coder-head retention in round_dir. Verify that the planned chmod timing, file-only hardening, and cleanup assumptions match the existing scripts and do not create stale-artifact or rerun hazards. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-coupling
archetypes.rationale: Targets fragile test-plan assumptions such as sed-based function extraction, helper placement, and coverage adequacy.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect whether the proposed tests can reliably extract and exercise the modified shell helpers without becoming coupled to brittle formatting or missing important branches. Compare the plan's line-specific extraction constraints, new in-repo fixture, outside-repo carryover cases, and chmod assertions against the current harness structure. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
